headline: Amendment to abolish the State Auditor fails in House
snippet: Got 46 yes but fell 17 votes short of three-fifths supermajority for constitutional amendment.

headline: Bill seeks to abolish the office of State Auditor
snippet: Sen. Jones proposed merging State Auditor into State Treasurer by 2031.

headline: Proposed constitutional amendment would abolish state auditor's office
snippet: Would have gone to voters on November 2022 ballot if passed.
